title: Cannabis Shopping Guides and Product Picks
metaDescription: A cannabis buying guide for Michigan shoppers: compare flower, vapes, edibles and concentrates, read a menu, shop on a budget and know what to ask.

hero.lead: Shopping smart starts before you reach the counter. Shopping & Reviews is our cannabis buying guide: how to compare flower, vapes, edibles and concentrates, how to read a menu, how to shop on a budget and what to ask your budtender. You'll also find seasonal picks and product round-ups. Prices and selection vary by store, so check the menu for today's options.
